story.angle: The season line (6IP) has to carry the claim before the narrative does: John Ellis bounces back in game 5 to win the A's their 7th World Series title under Mike Paulson. Eric Taveras fittingly provides the power along with veterans Darrin Davis , and Mark Aitken. Vinnie Keane , Benji Dillon appear in their final games.
